summary_cases.body_excerpt:
# INFO-1149 --- DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 memory sizing on a 256GB unified-memory Mac Studio

Whether DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 fits in 256GB of Apple Silicon unified memory, and at what quantization.

---

# Answer

Yes, at Q3-Q4 quantization — not at full precision or Q8.

DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is a 284B-total-parameter MoE model with 13B activated per token, a 1M-token context window, and MLA (multi-head latent attention) for a compact KV cache. Only the total resident weight footprint matters for the memory-fit question; the 13B activated-param count affects decode throughput, not whether the weights fit.

| Quant | ~Bits/param | Est. weight size | Fits 256GB unified memory? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FP16 | 16 | ~568 GB | No |
| Q8 | 8 | ~284 GB | No |
| Q4_K_M | ~4.5 | ~160-170 GB | Yes, with headroom for context/OS |
| Q3_K_M | ~3.5 | ~125-135 GB | Yes, comfortably |
| Q2_K | ~2.5 | ~90-100 GB | Yes, very comfortably (real quality hit) |

Recommendation: Q4_K_M for quality with some context headroom, or Q3_K_M to actually exercise the long context window.

## Real MLX builds (as of 2026-08-20)

Community MLX conversions already exist and confirm the estimate above:

| Repo | Precision | Size on disk | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` | 8-bit | ~284 GB | Straight conversion from `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`; doesn't fit 256GB |
| `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-4bit` | 4-bit | 152.2 GB (LLM Explorer) | Matches the Q4_K_M estimate closely; fits 256GB with real headroom |
| `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-2.4bit-mixed` | mixed, ~2.44 bit effective | 92.8 GB | Sensitive layers kept higher-bit; most headroom for long context |
| `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-2bit-DQ` | 2-bit dynamic | smaller than the 4-bit baseline | Routed experts at 2-bit, sensitive layers/projections at 4/6/8-bit |
| `Vontra/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-MXFP4-MLX` | MXFP4 native | — | Native FP4 format rather than a K-quant-style conversion |
| `ssd-moe/deepseek-v4-flash-mlx` (GitHub, not HF weights) | — | targets 48GB Macs | Custom SSD expert-streaming offload engine, not a memory-resident checkpoint — ~4.5-5 tok/s |

For a 256GB Mac Studio, `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-4bit` (152GB) is the closest real match to the Q4_K_M estimate; `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-2.4bit-mixed` (92.8GB) leaves the most room to actually use the 1M context window.

**Caveat**: `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-OptiQ-2bit` advertises a 304B-param model running in "6.5 GB of RAM" — not physically possible (304B params at 1-bit alone is ~38GB minimum before overhead). Treat that listing's numbers as unreliable rather than a real option.

## KV cache at 1M context

The 1M context window's cost is a separate budget line from the weight size above, and it varies a lot by how much of DeepSeek's attention-compression stack a given serving engine actually applies:

| Config | Per-token cost (bf16) | Total @ 1M context |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MLA only (measured, vLLM issue #51041) | ~56 KB/token | ~55 GB |
| MLA + sequence-dim "Compressed Attention" (c4a/c128a, DeepSeek's own figure) | further 4-128x reduction | ~9.6 GiB |
| DeepSeek-V3 baseline, for comparison (MLA only, no sequence compression) | ~70 KB/token | ~70 GB |

MLA alone (the same mechanism V3 uses) takes DeepSeek-V4-Flash from GQA-scale KV cache (300+ KB/token) down to ~56 KB/token. V4 layers a second, sequence-dimension compression on top (grouping 4-128 tokens into one compressed slot) that gets DeepSeek's own advertised figure down to ~9.6 GiB at 1M tokens — but whether a given serving stack (vLLM, MLX, Ollama) actually enables that second layer is implementation-dependent. The vLLM GitHub issue that supplied the 56 KB/token figure shows a deployment capped at ~121K tokens without the deeper compression engaged, i.e. the worst-case number.

Combined with the `mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-4bit` weight size (152GB): worst case (MLA only) is 152GB + ~55GB ≈ 207GB, tight but fits under 256GB once OS overhead is counted; best case (full Compressed Attention support) is 152GB + ~9.6GB ≈ 162GB, comfortable. Whether the MLX conversion gets the deeper compression is unconfirmed — check the model card/config before assuming best case.

# Context

- Precedent: DeepSeek-R1/V3 (671B total, ~2.4x larger) already runs at Q4 (~380-400GB) on 512GB Mac Studios and at Q2/Q3 (~150-230GB) on 192-256GB units. V4-Flash's 284B total scales down proportionally from that same family of quants.
- macOS caps GPU-usable memory below total physical RAM by default. Raise `iogpu.wired_limit` via `sysctl` to reclaim more of the 256GB for the model.
- The 1M context window is a second constraint independent of weight size: running near full context alongside a Q4 weight load eats into the remaining headroom — see the KV cache table above for concrete numbers rather than a general caveat.
- The community 4-bit and 2.44-bit-mixed MLX builds (above) validate these estimates against real published checkpoints; no on-device benchmark on this specific 256GB machine has been run yet.

# See Also

- [[INFO-1010-homelab-llm-memory-math-how-much-ram-does-a-model-need]] — general LLM memory-sizing math this entry applies to a specific model/machine pairing
